paper.title_en: A cosmic-ray database update: CRDB v4.2
paper.abstract_en: The cosmic-ray database, CRDB, has provided data and meta-data to the community since 2013. We present a new release, CRDB v4.2, which includes data and time series published in the last three years (from AMS-02, CALET, DAMPE, LHAASO, etc.), datasets missed in previous releases, and all peer-reviewed ultra-high energy cosmic-ray data (both historical and recent datasets). These data and meta-data are available from the web interface or from the CRDB pip-installable Python library. This release includes results from more than 60 experiments and publications, corresponding to 4534 new data points and 131624 time-series data points.
